1999.note: The 1998-99 season was shortened to 50 games by a lockout that ran from July 1998 to January 1999.

2012.note: The 2011-12 season was shortened to 66 games by a lockout that ran from July 2011 to December 2011.

2020.note: The 2019-20 regular season was halted in March 2020 with ~65-70 games played per team; the season resumed in a single-site bubble in Orlando in July 2020.

2021.note: The 2020-21 season was shortened to 72 games and started two months late (Dec 22) due to ongoing COVID disruption.
